newsitem.title: PERU: Spain's Repsol to invest $230 mln in Peru by 2001.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol to invest $230 mln in Peru by 2001.

text.p: Spain's oil company Repsol SA said Tuesday it plans to invest $230 million in its projects in Peru in the next five years.
Repsol planned to invest by 2001 "in the areas of marketing and Liquid Gas Petroleum more than $200 million," the company said in a statement.

Repsol, which led in June a consortium that bought a 60 percent stake in the government's La Pampilla refinery, also said it would invest jointly with its partners over the next five years $117 million in the refinery.

In the consortium that bought the La Pampilla stake for $180.5 million, Repsol had a 45 percent share, with the option of increasing its stake to 55 percent. Its partners in the consortium were Argentina's YPF, Mobil Corp. and several local companies.
Repsol's operations in Peru include the La Pampilla refinery, gasoline stations and exploration projects.
